meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你调试并修复 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug：先复现、写失败测试、做最小修复并验证，然后交付——上游 Codex 开 fork PR，LazyCodex 仓库发带补丁的 issue，绝不发 PR。
howto.when: 当你说要修 bug、提交 bug 修复、为 bug 开 PR 等时。

say.text: 帮我修一下 LazyCodex 的某个 bug 并提交修复。
这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 请帮忙修并开个 PR。
调试并 PR 这个 Codex 缺陷。
say.note: Claude 会复现、修复并创建 PR。

howto.what_en: Claude debugs and fixes LazyCodex or Codex bugs: it reproduces the issue, writes a failing test, implements the smallest fix, verifies it, then delivers a fork PR for upstream openai/codex, or a verified-fix issue with the patch for the LazyCodex repo (never a PR).
howto.when_en: When the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Please fix a bug in LazyCodex and submit the fix.
say_en.note: Claude will file a verified-fix issue with the patch, not a PR.

say_en.text: Please fix this Codex CLI bug and open a PR.
say_en.note: Claude will create a fork PR for upstream openai/codex.

say_en.text: Debug and PR this Codex defect.
say_en.note: Claude will reproduce, fix, and create a PR.
